definition.simple: A mixture where the pieces are large enough to see and will settle down if you leave it alone.
definition.academic: A heterogeneous mixture containing solid particles that are sufficiently large for sedimentation.

common_misconceptions: Thinking suspensions are permanent. Suspensions will settle over time if left undisturbed.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If you leave the muddy water in a glass for an hour, what happens to the mud?
